notes: TsetlinWiSARD is not a clause-based TM: a WiSARD weightless NN (one discriminator per class of n-input LUTs over a random feature shuffle) whose LUT entries are each learned by one TA (2N states, MSB = entry value). Clause count, T, s, literal budget and weighting are not applicable (null). Feedback only on misclassification: increment TAs of the true discriminator and decrement those of the predicted one, each LUT independently with probability P (P = 0.1/0.5/0.9 studied in Figs. 6-7; 0.5 via LFSR on chip). Fig. 3/4/6/7/10 are curves without printed numbers and were not extracted; Fig. 10's TM comparison uses 6/12/18 clauses (MNIST/FMNIST/KMNIST), 10/20/30 (EMG), 8/18/26 (HAR, GPS), scope not stated. No train/test sizes, seeds or run counts are given. n_classes for EMG, HAR and GPS are not stated in the paper.
